games.reason: HOXB13 is supported by a directly mapped own QBiC-SELEX model with a strong ref-over-alt binding prediction, and it is highly expressed with a ChIP-seq summit 11 bp from the variant in LNCaP (E25, E13). Chain B has a nearby VDR ChIP-seq summit and VDR expression, but its alt-binding prediction comes from the NR2F6 model, while several possible family members are expressed; the evidence does not directly tie that binding change to VDR (E14, E26).

HOXB13 is much more directly supported: it is highly expressed in LNCaP and has a ChIP-seq summit 11 bp from the variant, while its own QBiC-SELEX model strongly predicts greater binding to ref T than alt C (E13, E25). For A, VDR has a nearby summit but lower expression, and the alt-favoring F2 model is the NR2F6 model; the evidence does not establish that VDR is the acting member (E14, E26). The element, target-gene, and phenotype evidence is otherwise shared and does not distinguish the chains.
